prompt:
Find real, documented measurements of WLED or ESP32-based LED controller reliability (uptime, failure rates) in long-running installations. Cite the sources and quote the figures.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
Here are the documented measurements of WLED and ESP32-based LED controller reliability found in the provided sources. 

While long-term reliability data for the hardware is available, specific failure rates (like a precise Mean Time Between Failures) for the WLED software are not documented; instead, the sources describe failure modes in terms of time-until-crash and uptime before/after software downgrades.

SOURCE: https://www.electrobob.com/led-logger-v3/ | QUOTE: "Very impressing, as at some point it has reached 4500 hours. Impressing for the power company, who never turned off the power for > 6 months." | CLAIM: An ESP8266-based LED logger achieved a continuous uptime of at least 4500 hours (over 6 months) without freezing or malfunctioning.
SOURCE: https://www.electrobob.com/led-logger-v3/ | QUOTE: "I cannot say the same for later bought modules (~1 year), as 2 of them had died already." | CLAIM: Later-purchased ESP8266 modules exhibited a 100% failure rate (2 out of 2 died) within approximately 1 year.
SOURCE: https://github.com/Aircoookie/WLED/issues/4347 | QUOTE: "After a couple of days, the device because unresponsible within Home Assistant as well as pinging it / access to the WebUI." | CLAIM: ESP32-C3 running WLED becomes unresponsive (crashes) after a couple of days of 24/7 operation.
SOURCE: https://github.com/Aircoookie/WLED/issues/4347 | QUOTE: "After downgrading to 0.15.1 on this ESP32-S2 the light currently shows an uptime of 7.5 days with no changes to the hardware, HA setup or power supply." | CLAIM: An ESP32-S2 running WLED version 0.15.1 achieved a stable uptime of 7.5 days, significantly longer than on version 0.15.3 which crashed every few days.
SOURCE: https://github.com/Aircoookie/WLED/issues/2750 | QUOTE: "Right now I have around 30 minutes uptime according to the 'info tab' and noticed flash multiple times." | CLAIM: WLED 0.13.2 on ESP32 experienced rapid flashing/glitching within a 30-minute uptime window prior to a fix.
SOURCE: https://github.com/Aircoookie/WLED/issues/4347 | QUOTE: "I've now had the ESP32-mini-SerKo alone powered via USB-C and no WLED mini shield and it's been going for over 9 days." | CLAIM: An ESP32-mini controller achieved over 9 days of stable uptime when isolated from its LED power shield.

NO_SOURCE_FOUND: A specific numerical failure rate (e.g., percentage of deployments failing per year) for WLED or ESP32 controllers in long-running installations.
